additional_info.subject: RE: RES: ID0378932-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197006] OCPP Offline CRM:00921001103
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Joao,
I hope you are doing well.
Based on our recent findings, we’ve identified that the main WAN interface for the XF4 router is currently set to Wi-Fi.
As you may know, Wi-Fi connections tend to be less stable compared to mobile (SIM) or wired connections.
To improve network stability and help diagnose any potential connectivity issues, we recommend switching the main WAN interface to either a mobile or wired connection with a physical WAN interface.
We hope this clarifies the situation, and if you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav
